description: Regression prompts for the ut-design skill (design/update a requirement-traceable unit test CSV).

expected_behavior: Reads docs/requirements.md before writing any cases.
Creates or updates docs/ut-design/unit-test-design.csv with the required 9-column header.
Produces at least one case per functional requirement (FR1-FR6).
Runs the fix_csv.py validator against the saved file before reporting completion.
Reports the artifact path and case count instead of dumping the full CSV into chat.
should_not: Invent numeric thresholds for FR5 that are not stated in the requirements.
Leave the saved CSV failing fix_csv.py --check-only.

evals.prompt: add a test case for when the boot_status field contains an unexpected numeric value instead of a string
expected_behavior: Appends a new row rather than rewriting unrelated existing rows.
Uses the next sequential UT-### id with no collision against existing ids.
Sets 'test case type' to a value from the allowed set (positive, negative, edge, boundary, exception, exhaustive).
should_not: Duplicate an existing case for the same scenario.

evals.prompt: design test cases for the CPU/memory/storage threshold checks
expected_behavior: Notices FR5's thresholds are left blank in the requirements.
Marks affected expected outputs as TBD with a comment naming the missing threshold/unit decision.
Still produces boundary-style cases (e.g. using the example values given in the requirements) where the input itself is unambiguous.
should_not: Fabricate a specific percentage threshold that isn't in the requirements.
Mark a TBD case as automated: yes.

evals.prompt: this csv is failing to parse, fix it: docs/ut-design/unit-test-design.csv
expected_behavior: Reports auto-fixed issues and any unresolved issues separately.
Re-validates with --check-only after fixing and confirms a clean result before finishing.
should_not: Hand-edit rows that the script already fixes without re-validating.
Silently ignore an 'unresolved' warning from the script.

evals.prompt: save the test design to test_output/cases.csv instead
expected_behavior: Honors the user-provided output path instead of the default docs/ut-design/ location.
Still applies the same 9-column contract and validation step at the new path.
